subject: Capacity & procurement playbook — cross-team workshop (scheduling)

Date: Mon, 07 Jun 2027 10:15:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Capacity & procurement playbook — can we lock a time?

Hey Sean / Marissa,

Thanks again for the demo last week — engineering and procurement found it useful. We want to run a 60-minute cross-functional session to align on:
- Brightline projected monthly token/embedding volumes for next 12 months (we'll bring an initial forecast)
- Dedicated pool sizing options and rough cost ranges
- Procurement checklist & timeline (PO, SOC2, contract redlines)

Can you propose a couple windows next week (prefer mornings ET)? I will invite my procurement lead (Liam) and our SecOps alias. I've attached a short usage template to fill ahead of time.

Attachments: brightline_usage_template.xlsx (excel, 12KB)

Thanks,
Samira Khan
Head of Platform Integrations
Brightline Health
samira@brightlinehealth.com

Samira — great to hear. Available windows next week (all ET):
- Tue 2027-06-08 10:00–11:00
- Wed 2027-06-09 09:00–10:00 or 11:00–12:00

We'll have Marissa cover pricing/packaging (Committed vs. burst), and Dev will run through the Dedicated sizing assumptions and KV cache behavior that affect cost.

Quick asks:
- Can you confirm whether SOC 2 Type II evidence needs to be in-hand before PO? If yes, we'll prioritize a short security pre-read.
- If you can start the usage template (attached) with month 1–6 and expected Q4 peak, that will make the sizing exercise faster.

I'll tentatively hold Wed 11:00–12:00 and send a calendar invite once we confirm attendees. Meeting length: 60 minutes. Zoom link TBD.

Thanks — Sean

Hi all — confirming Wed 2027-06-09 11:00–12:00 ET for the cross-functional workshop. Calendar invite sent (Zoom + dial-in).

Agenda (60m):
1) 5m — Intros + goals (Samira)
2) 15m — Brightline usage forecast walkthrough (Samira / Liam)
3) 20m — Dedicated sizing recommendations (Dev) — assumptions, KV/cache, expected tail latency at peak
4) 10m — Commercial options & pricing band (Marissa) — committed vs burst, uplift for higher availability
5) 10m — Procurement & security checklist + next steps (Sean / Evelyn)

Pre-reads attached: redwood-dedicated-sizing-playbook.pdf (summary of sizing methodology) and a short SOC2 summary. Please populate the usage template Samira sent if possible; we'll use it during the sizing whiteboard.

Attachments: redwood-dedicated-sizing-playbook.pdf (pdf, 420KB); SOC2-summary.txt (text, 8KB)

Next steps: after the workshop we'll produce a mutual action plan with PO timeline milestones and an initial committed-capacity proposal.
